create_timing_dict: create a Timing dict to track elapsed time for multiple named operations using context managers
use_timeit_context: use the timeit context manager to measure and record time for a specific key
use_add_time_context: use the add_time context manager to accumulate elapsed time across multiple calls for a key
use_avg_time_context: use the avg_time context manager to track a windowed running average of elapsed time for a key
review_TimingContext_class: review the TimingContext class and its enter and exit methods for timing context management
